[[File:Compost detail.png|left|130px]]
'''Compost''' is an item used in the [[Farming]] skill to reduce the chance of a farming patch becoming [[Disease (Farming)|diseased]] per growth stage by 50 %.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Kieren|url=https://twitter.com/JagexKieren/status/906202229677359104|date=7 September 2017|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/109604|archivedate=28 May 2020|quote=So with the release of [[Ultracompost]] I figured I'd explain how compost affects crops dying. Sorry it is very word heavy! Fire any questions:)}} When used on a farming patch, each bucket grants 18 Farming experience.

It also increases the minimum yield and maximum number of harvests received from [[allotment]]s, [[hops]] and [[herb]]s.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1088561370432487424|date=24 January 2019|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/106504|archivedate=28 May 2020|quote=[Flower/berry/cactus patches] don't depend on the compost state. Allotments, hops and herbs do.}} The minimum number of herbs per harvest increases to 4.{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1131004000256630791|date=22 May 2019|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/104362|archivedate=21 September 2021|quote=4 for standard compost, 5 for super compost, 6 for the ultra one.}} This also applies to [[giant seaweed]] patches [[underwater]]{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1019207794350845953|date=17 July 2018|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/108470|archivedate=28 May 2020|quote=[Does compost increase giant seaweed yield?] Yeah.}} and [[celastrus bark]] from a fully grown [[celastrus seed]].{{CiteTwitter|author=Mod Ash|url=https://twitter.com/JagexAsh/status/1088630402284224512|date=24 January 2019|archiveurl=https://reldo.runescape.wiki/i/98850|archivedate=28 May 2020|quote=Yes, celastrus would be helped by composting.}}

Compost can be upgraded into [[supercompost]] by using one dose of [[compost potion]] on either a bucket of regular compost, or a [[compost bin]] filled with regular compost. Supercompost can also be made directly without a compost potion, by filling the compost bin with [[Supercompost#Suitable_items|higher-level produce]]. It can be upgraded further into [[ultracompost]] by using 25 [[volcanic ash]] on the bin of [[supercompost]], while [[big compost bin]]s, such as the one in the [[Farming Guild]], require 50 volcanic ash.

==Uses==
Three buckets of compost can be used as payment for a farmer to watch over [[barley seed]]s as they grow, or two buckets for [[potato seed]]s.

==Creation==
Compost can be made at [[farming patches]] by putting 15 items (including [[weeds]], [[sweetcorn]], and other farming produce) into a [[compost bin]]. It takes 60 minutes after a compost bin is closed for the vegetation to become 15 [[buckets]] worth of compost. Filling a bucket with compost gives 4.5 Farming [[experience]], and collecting all of the compost from a full compost bin yields 67.5 Farming experience. 

Compost can be bought from [[farming shops]], such as those near the cabbage patch south of [[Falador]], and [[Alice's Farming Shop]] north-west of [[Port Phasmatys]].

<nowiki>*</nowiki>Ironmen wishing to create their own compost rather than buy it can use the [[Cabbages (plant)|cabbages]] south of the Falador allotment, the [[Potato|potatoes]] west of the Ardougne allotment, or the [[wheat]] north-east of the Catherby allotment on their respective compost bins as a free source of compost generation. The various [[Leaves (disambiguation)|leaves]] from [[Forestry]] also work well since they are gained passively through the activity and are stackable in the inventory.
